verdict.rationale: Sprinto's docs and GitHub skills describe automation across many controls/items (80% automation of manual effort, full-repo PII/GDPR scans covering 99 articles, continuous monitoring across multiple frameworks) which implies bulk-style processing, but there is no explicit bulk-operation feature (e.g., multi-select and batch-apply actions, or a bulk API endpoint) documented anywhere in the evidence pack. Missing for 10: explicit bulk-edit/bulk-assign UI functionality, a documented batch API for acting on many items at once, and independent confirmation of scale/performance for bulk actions.
